Record Class SqlTableDistribution

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.model.schema.sql.SqlTableDistribution
Record Components:
type - The distribution type
keyColumns - The sharding key columns of a sharded table, empty for a duplicated table
parent - The table mapping of the root table of the table family, if a sharded table is a child table
tablespace - The tablespace set of a sharded table, or the tablespace of a duplicated table, if any
@Internal public record SqlTableDistribution(SqlTableDistribution.Type type, List<String> keyColumns, @Nullable SqlTableDistribution.ParentTable parent, @Nullable String tablespace) extends Record
How a table is distributed across the shards of an Oracle Globally Distributed Database.
Since:
5.3
